entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Caroline Crouch was a Greek student of British and Filipino descent who was murdered on the morning of 11 May 2021, in her home on Glyka Nera, a suburb of Athens, Greece. 37 days later, her husband, Babis Anagnostopoulos, confessed to the police under interrogation that he was the one who murdered her. On 22 June, he was imprisoned on charges of murder and animal abuse. The case was extensively covered by Greek and international media due to developments during its investigation.
